title: Quiz from its handbook
summary: Opens one of the checked quiz sets this persona's pack carries, by chapter, in Quiznect's player over the chat. In a private chat no answer is recorded.
whenToUse: Use when the person asks to be quizzed or tested. Pass the chapter number they said; leave it empty when they named none.

arguments.name: chapter
arguments.description: The chapter number they asked for, such as 5

privateChat.keeps: Nothing. Your answers stay on the quiz screen and go when you close it.

_note: Phase FL.10 (2026-11-16): a step for a companion pack (agent.mode "companion"), which chats as a persona and takes a step only when the person asks. It carries no route words: the pack's own `agent.ask` phrases offer it, so the general Agent's router never does.
